## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of KCA flows in edge multi-tenant deployments, emphasizing lightweight devices, offline revocation, policy binding, and auditability.

## Key Concepts

- Attestation to bootstrap
- SPIFFE IDs and TLS cert binding
- Per-tenant policy binding
- Offline revocation checks and revocation lists
- Certificate rotation and renewal on reconnect
- Auditing and tamper-evident logs

## Code Example

```javascript
function needsRotation(cert) {
  const remaining = cert.notAfter - Date.now();
  return remaining < 60_000;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test revocation propagation during network partitions?
- What are trade-offs between short TTL and OCSP stapling in offline mode?
